architecture_findings: The active topology is a four-workflow monolithic fallback. Auto Sync runs source discovery and source assessment as ordered stages in one bounded workflow; the independent script_assess_sources adapter is disabled with no allowed callers.

script_discover_sources produces a same-run runner-local discovered_sources artifact. script_assess_sources consumes that exact artifact after digest verification, assesses at most 100 URLs per run with a 1 MB per-URL and 10 MB aggregate cap, and keeps activation_count at zero.

Assessment history, runtime and report are runner-local immutable artifacts. script_register_discovered_sources merges only verified assessment results into rulesets/source_candidate_registry.json under the enclosing production-pipeline lease; no per-URL automation/task_queue.json checkpoint is active.

The registry manifest preserves the assessment cursor and per-source fingerprints, but pending-assessment backlog is not yet an independent scheduler demand. Multiple consecutive cursor-advancing Auto Sync runs remain an open end-to-end acceptance gate.

The production publisher stages and publishes only rulesets/**. Watchdog/Storage Management queue and incident control-plane writes are separately fenced and do not expand the production publisher allowlist.

No automated config-baseline metadata writer exists in this proposal-only branch. Baseline observation produces a runner-local proposal; approved uu.conf Blob SHA and Release pin changes require a separate reviewed PR. modules/uu.conf remains byte-for-byte read-only to automation.
Other non-dispatchable Python capabilities remain default-deny until their complete transitive side-effect and resource contracts are reviewed.
decomposition_constraints: Preserve the audit -> publish dependency and the existing single-writer concurrency boundary.
A capability can run alone only after its input snapshot, output artifacts, dependencies, resource leases, timeout/retry, idempotency and independent verifier are implemented.
The publish job must not be decomposed into independently writable capability jobs without a single controlled publisher.
The review cursor recovery job runs only after audit failure and must remain a recovery path.
Dashboard generation is observer-only and is not a production stage.

review_context.note: Descriptive only; no additional write/dispatch authorization. Production publication is rulesets/** only. modules/uu.conf remains byte-for-byte read-only. Config baseline observation produces a runner-local proposal only; approved Blob SHA and derived Release metadata changes require a separate reviewed pull request. No automatic Storage Management baseline writer exists.

repository_write_policy: Per-capability explicit exclusive resource_contract.resource_keys; control-plane state is separately inventoried. The production publisher stages only the three ruleset deliverables under rulesets/**; this is not a global automation write restriction.
